input: words1 and words2 are lists of at most 10000 lowercase ASCII strings each; every word length is in [0,1000]. Duplicate candidate/constraint words and empty lists/words are accepted. Integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool; list and string inputs are ordinary list/str values without subclasses. No concurrent mutation or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Size bounds do not guarantee available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: A fresh list containing every words1 occurrence that contains, as a multiset, every words2 word. Candidate order and duplicate occurrences are preserved. Requirements are the per-letter MAXIMUM across constraint words, not the sum across all words2. Empty words2 accepts every words1 occurrence.
mutation_aliasing: All input values, caller containers and ordering remain unchanged. The Solution instance retains no state and separate calls share no mutable result state. Fresh 26-entry frequency arrays are temporary; the returned outer list is fresh and contains immutable original string values, whose identities need not be fresh.
numeric: Character indices lie in [0,25]. Every frequency and required count is at most 1000, with no count multiplication or unsafe accumulated whole-string hash.
complexity: O(total characters+26*(len(words1)+len(words2))+1) time. O(26) live auxiliary count storage excluding O(result count+1) returned references; O(26*(word count)+1) temporary slots are allocated over the call. No per-candidate rescanning of every constraint word is used.

helpers.name: letter_counts
helpers.contract: Allocate a fresh 26-entry array and count each lowercase ASCII letter. No normalization, sorting or shared mutable array is used.
helpers.cost: The complete helper definition/statement is 151 UTF-8 bytes including indentation and terminal newline, already included in total source. O(word length+26) time and O(26) newly allocated space per call, all charged.
